stories.summary: The FDA has rejected ivonescimab, a treatment for a type of lung cancer developed by U.S. biotech Summit Therapeutics and the Chinese drugmaker Akeso.

stories.headline: STAT+: Apple and OpenEvidence launch experimental health chat app
stories.summary: Apple and OpenEvidence are launching a study based around an experimental AI-powered health chat app, hinting at possible new directions for both companies.
